Letter from Levi Wallace talking about what he went through to play football throughout the years
stories.summary:
Kind of a neat article for those of you who subscribe to the Athletic.  It's a letter written by Levi Wallace's mind to his body, kind of apologizing to his body for the things he put his body through to play football.  Below is the first and last couple of paragraphs, starts out from when he first played flag football at age 5 up until he decided to retire. 



	 



	Article was called "Here's the truth from a retiring NFL player"



	 



	Dear Body,



	The time has finally come for me to acknowledge that we are in agreement. It is time for us to call it quits.



	 



	I owe you a letter that tells the truth. Not the highlight version. The real one. The version where people saw us on Sundays but never saw what it took to get there.



	 



	..........



	 



	 



	Somewhere along the way, we learned how to carry each other, Body and Mind.



	 



	Truth be told, Body, I wouldn’t change a thing. I’d put us through it all over again. Because I know what we are capable of.



	 



	I know what God built us to endure.



	 



	I know we can handle it together.



	 



	Sincerely,



	Levi Wallace’s Mind



	 



	 



	https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7646085/2026/10/01/levi-wallace-nfl-retirement-letter/

Trade for BTJ?
stories.summary:
Brian Thomas Jr. appears to be moving towards WR4 in Jax and seems logical he could be traded. See excerpt from SI fantasy writers below. Would love to take a mid-late round flyer on him if Jax was willing to trade to a contender. Too much talent there. Gotta wonder what he could do on the outside with Moore in our offense with JA17 throwing him the ball. Make it happen Beane!!



	 



	Coen: BTJ off field more because of 12-personnel



	Jaguars coach Liam Coen said Brian Thomas Jr. played only 23 snaps in Week 3 because the Jaguars “were playing in a little bit more 12 and also some of the things that we had Josh [Cameron] on specifically were things that we felt good about him doing within a role that he has.”



	Advice: Sports Illustrated’s John Shipley believes that Cameron’s usage (23 snaps) could make it “stand[s] to reason Thomas could quickly become the fourth option instead” in a column that says he believes a “new start would be best for both parties.” It sounds like there’s a non-zero chance that Thomas is on the trade block at the deadline, as weird as that seems given how good the Jaguars have been on offense. Thomas isn’t necessarily someone who has to be rostered in shallow leagues given how things are trending.

stories.title: Five undefeated teams left after three weeks…W4 preview
stories.summary:
Bills, Chiefs, Raiders, 49ers, Vikings at 3-0 — and I think to the majority of us, all or most of those are a surprise.



	 



	Equally as surprising are a number of the winless and 1-2 teams: Rams, Chargers, Packers, Pats***, Texans, Cowboys…



	 



	Next week marks end of the proverbial first quarter of the season, when teams start to solidify “who they are.”



	 



	Some really interesting games on the slate for W4. Obviously there’s Bills/Pats*** and a chance for Buffalo to put an early stranglehold on the division. KC/LV will eliminate one of the unbeatens. Houston and Dallas are both in desperation mode in the battle of Texas. Jags at Cinci is a matchup of 2-1 teams. Broncos at 49ers is another intriguing game — one could argue Denver “should” be 0-3 but they’ve done the 4th quarter rabbit-out-of-a-hat trick two weeks in a row.



	 



	From a Bills perspective I think we’re rooting for Vegas, Dallas, Jacksonville (because of Cinci’s easy schedule), and the 49ers.



	 



	Fun week ahead.
